# clio mcp schema-export

Print/write the tool_schema pack (alias: --path)

## Usage

```
clio mcp schema-export [--out FILE] [--path FILE] [--tools PRESET]
```

## Description

--out FILE writes the pack to a file; --path is an accepted alias.
With neither flag the pack is written to stdout.

--tools narrows the pack to a tool-group selection: minimal, coding, ops, all, or custom:GROUP[,GROUP] for the minimal set plus the listed groups and what they require. With no --tools the pack holds every tool in the catalog.

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out FILE` | text |  | Pack file `mcp_cli` writes. |
| `--path FILE` | text |  | Alias of `--out` for the pack. |
| `--tools PRESET` | text |  | Tool groups the pack holds: `minimal`, `coding`, `ops`, `all`, or custom:GROUP[,GROUP] for the minimal set plus the listed groups and what they require. With no --tools the pack holds the whole catalog. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Print the tool schema pack to stdout.
```
clio mcp schema-export
```

Write the pack to a file.
```
clio mcp schema-export --out ./tools.json
```

Write through the accepted alias spelling.
```
clio mcp schema-export --path ./tools.json
```
